newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian housing sector recovering - Howard.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian housing sector recovering - Howard.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard said on Monday the housing sector, which has been weakening for about two years, was beginning to recover, but that the manufacturing sector was flat.
"The housing sector is beginning to recover," Howard told Sydney radio station 2UE.
"Manufacturing is flat -- it was always expected to be flat in this quarter," he said.
Howard said the government had tackled the budget deficit problem it inherited to get the economy going again.

"If the senate lets the budget through, we will have done an almighty service to the Australian business community for the next two or three years because we will have delivered the circumstances for a low interest rate climate," he said.
The government announced A$7.2 billion in budget savings over the next two years to push the budget into surplus by 1998/99.
Howard also said the government's reforms to labour relations laws would help the economy if passed by the senate.
"I hope over the next few weeks we will know the fate of that legislation," he said.
